label: Raccoon girl

label: Sentimental prankster

label: Protective
prompt_hint: Not controlling: attentive. She notices when someone is being sidelined and has a calm, formidable way of making room.

label: Velvet glove

label: Earnest nerd

label: Lover of nice things
prompt_hint: Has an eye for texture, service and little rituals of pleasure. She can enjoy a bargain as much as silk if it has a story.

label: Delightfully strange

label: Decisive

label: Haunted romantic
prompt_hint: Believes in grand feeling but distrusts easy declarations. She is not tragic; she is selective with hope.

label: Sunny troublemaker

label: Reserved flirt
prompt_hint: Keeps her cards close until she has a reason not to, then drops one devastatingly specific line and lets it sit.

label: Chaos scholar

label: Devoted

label: Restless artist

label: Cool under pressure

label: Playful precision

label: Gentle mischief
